## Dataset provenance

This vignette documents clinical-only TCGA-BRCA modeling examples prepared for
OmicsKit. The modeling data are derived from real TCGA-BRCA clinical and
survival inputs:

- `inst/extdata/brca/raw_xena/TCGA.BRCA.sampleMap_BRCA_clinicalMatrix`
- `inst/extdata/brca/raw_xena/BRCA_survival.txt`

The heavy data preparation and model fitting are performed outside the vignette
in `data-raw/brca/08_prepare_modeling_objects_brca.R`. This vignette loads
package-ready objects from `data/` and displays real prerendered figures from
`vignettes/figures/`.

```{r packages}
library(OmicsKit)
```

```{r load_objects}
data(brca_clinical_modeling_data)
data(brca_cox_univariable_clinical)
data(brca_cox_adjusted_clinical)
data(brca_glm_stage_clinical)
data(brca_roc_stage_clinical)

list(
  clinical_rows = nrow(brca_clinical_modeling_data),
  clinical_columns = ncol(brca_clinical_modeling_data),
  cox_univariable_rows = nrow(brca_cox_univariable_clinical),
  cox_adjusted_rows = nrow(brca_cox_adjusted_clinical)
)
```

## Clinical-only design

These examples intentionally use clinical variables only. Molecular scores,
expression principal components, molecular subtype calls, and molecular cluster
variables are not used in the modeling examples.

For the binary `stage_advanced` GLM/ROC example, stage-defining variables are
also excluded from the predictor set. In particular, `AJCC_Stage_nature2012`,
`AJCC_stage_broad`, `pathologic_T`, `pathologic_N`, and `pathologic_M` are not
used as predictors for `stage_advanced`.

```{r clinical_columns}
intersect(
  c(
    "sample", "patient", "OS", "OS.time", "PFI", "PFI.time",
    "age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis", "age_group",
    "ER_Status_nature2012", "PR_Status_nature2012",
    "HER2_Final_Status_nature2012", "AJCC_stage_broad",
    "stage_advanced", "histological_type", "menopause_status",
    "radiation_therapy", "history_of_neoadjuvant_treatment"
  ),
  names(brca_clinical_modeling_data)
)
```

## Survival endpoint

The Cox modeling examples use progression-free interval:

- `PFI.time`: progression-free interval time
- `PFI`: progression-free interval event indicator

The Kaplan-Meier example below uses overall survival for a simple age-group
visualization, while the Cox models focus on PFI.

```{r endpoint_summary}
data.frame(
  endpoint = c("OS", "PFI"),
  time_col = c("OS.time", "PFI.time"),
  n_with_time = c(
    sum(is.finite(brca_clinical_modeling_data$OS.time)),
    sum(is.finite(brca_clinical_modeling_data$PFI.time))
  ),
  n_events = c(
    sum(brca_clinical_modeling_data$OS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(brca_clinical_modeling_data$PFI == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)
```

## nice_KM with age_group or ER clinical status

`nice_KM()` renders Kaplan-Meier curves for a grouping variable and a survival
endpoint. The prepared BRCA figure uses clinical `age_group` with `OS.time` and
`OS`.

```{r nice_km_age_call, eval = FALSE}
nice_KM(
  data = brca_clinical_modeling_data,
  gene = "age_group",
  time_var = "OS.time",
  event_var = "OS",
  title_prefix = "",
  conf_int = TRUE,
  risk_table = FALSE
)
```

```{r km_age_figure, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Clinical-only Kaplan-Meier example for TCGA-BRCA age group using overall survival.", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
knitr::include_graphics("figures/brca_km_age_OS.png")
```

If `ER_Status_nature2012` has enough samples and events in the prepared
clinical data, the same function can be used with PFI:

```{r nice_km_er_call, eval = FALSE}
nice_KM(
  data = brca_clinical_modeling_data,
  gene = "ER_Status_nature2012",
  time_var = "PFI.time",
  event_var = "PFI",
  title_prefix = ""
)
```

## get_cox clinical-only

`get_cox()` fits univariable, multivariable, or adjusted Cox proportional
hazards models and returns tidy tables ready for downstream plotting. The
prepared BRCA Cox examples use PFI as the outcome and clinical-only candidate
variables.

```{r get_cox_call, eval = FALSE}
clinical_cox_vars <- c(
  "age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis",
  "age_group",
  "ER_Status_nature2012",
  "PR_Status_nature2012",
  "HER2_Final_Status_nature2012",
  "AJCC_stage_broad",
  "pathologic_T",
  "pathologic_N",
  "pathologic_M",
  "histological_type",
  "menopause_status",
  "radiation_therapy",
  "history_of_neoadjuvant_treatment"
)

brca_cox_univariable_clinical <- get_cox(
  data = brca_clinical_modeling_data,
  time_col = "PFI.time",
  event_col = "PFI",
  vars = clinical_cox_vars,
  model = "univariable"
)

brca_cox_adjusted_clinical <- get_cox(
  data = brca_clinical_modeling_data,
  time_col = "PFI.time",
  event_col = "PFI",
  vars = clinical_cox_vars,
  model = "adjusted",
  adjust_vars = c("age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis", "AJCC_stage_broad")
)
```

```{r cox_preview}
head(brca_cox_univariable_clinical)
```

## nice_forest clinical-only

`nice_forest()` visualizes the tidy Cox output from `get_cox()`. The figure
below is prerendered from the prepared clinical-only Cox object.

```{r nice_forest_call, eval = FALSE}
nice_forest(
  brca_cox_adjusted_clinical,
  title = "TCGA-BRCA clinical Cox model for PFI",
  sort_by = "p.value"
)
```

```{r forest_figure, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Clinical-only Cox model forest plot for TCGA-BRCA progression-free interval.", fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
knitr::include_graphics("figures/brca_forest_cox_clinical_pfi.png")
```

## GLM stage_advanced prediction

The GLM example predicts `stage_advanced`, where:

- `0` means Stage I-II
- `1` means Stage III-IV

The model uses a 60/40 train/test split with `set.seed(2025)` and clinical
predictors only. It does not use AJCC stage, broad AJCC stage, pathologic T,
pathologic N, or pathologic M as predictors because those variables define or
closely encode the outcome.

```{r glm_call, eval = FALSE}
clinical_glm_predictors <- c(
  "age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis",
  "ER_Status_nature2012",
  "PR_Status_nature2012",
  "HER2_Final_Status_nature2012",
  "histological_type",
  "menopause_status"
)

brca_glm_stage_clinical <- get_glm(
  data = brca_glm_stage_train,
  outcome = "stage_advanced",
  predictors = clinical_glm_predictors,
  family = "binomial"
)
```

```{r glm_preview}
brca_glm_stage_clinical
```

## nice_ROC clinical-only

`nice_ROC()` evaluates the clinical-only GLM on held-out test data and renders
the ROC curve with AUC. The object `brca_roc_stage_clinical` contains the
prepared ROC result; the figure below is prerendered from that object.

```{r roc_call, eval = FALSE}
nice_ROC(
  models = list("Clinical only" = clinical_glm_fit),
  data = brca_glm_stage_test,
  outcome = "stage_advanced",
  show_delong = FALSE,
  return_data = TRUE
)
```

```{r roc_summary}
if (is.list(brca_roc_stage_clinical) &&
    "auc_table" %in% names(brca_roc_stage_clinical)) {
  brca_roc_stage_clinical$auc_table
} else {
  brca_roc_stage_clinical
}
```

```{r roc_figure, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Clinical-only ROC curve for TCGA-BRCA advanced-stage prediction.", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
knitr::include_graphics("figures/brca_roc_stage_clinical.png")
```
